scientific_integrity: Symbolic classification and sharp relative collision proved; finite standard-library verifier is corroborative, not a proof of historical novelty.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to connected finite simple block graphs with exact degree-two/degree-three incidence constraints. No minimum for all block graphs or higher-dimensional Weisfeiler-Leman is claimed. Historical priority provisional.
title: A sharp counting-logic collision threshold inside degree-biregular block graphs
